title: Manager - Safety
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. Our capability as an integrated service provider & experience with various technologies enables us to serve Innovator and Generic companies worldwide. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Manager
- Safety Job Description
1. Process safety lead and Industrial hygienist as well as handling the Emergencies. Day-to-day process safety management such as review of Management of Change, RFP, Process Safety Information, BMR, Design Basis, Procedures, Participating in HAZOP or LOPA, PSSR, Incident Investigations, Audits and Asset Integrity Management. ⮚Active role in the organization’s initiative on process safety improvement program at site. ⮚Primary responsibility of Process Safety Management in the site. ⮚Carrying out & tracking HAZARD Studies for existing and new processes thru multi- disciplinary teams. ⮚Analysis of all change controls raised in the plant for safety impact and recommending safety requirements (Management of Change). Verification of the Mo C recommendations. ⮚Pre-Start-up Safety Review of the newly installed systems or after major modifications in the plants. Identifying the pre and post start-up requirements. ⮚Having good knowledge, implementation of Management systems like ISO-14001 &
45001. ⮚Implementing electrical equipment for zone classification, integrity of flame-proof worthiness, equipment earthing, isolation during maintenance works (LOTO) and adherence to electrical procedures / standards. ⮚Ensure all incidents are reported in the system and conduct investigations; developing root cause analysis and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions. ⮚Preparation, Co-ordination for second party, external audits, customer audits and monitor corrective and preventive actions for closure. ⮚Conducting process safety audits or inspections on a periodical basis, in all sections of the plant and rectifying the gaps found. ⮚Static controls: Create awareness, training plant persons, providing tools, monitoring usage. ⮚Analysis of leading & lagging indicators and taking appropriate actions. ⮚Implementation of Site EHS procedures. ⮚Supporting Safety & Health CAPEX projects as per timeline. ⮚Supporting and implementation of Project Light house – Safety Cultural transformation journey in the unit. The candidate will act as an SME for QA activities during night shifts and support continuous quality improvement through trend analysis and risk assessment activities. Responsibilities also include managing the Approved Supplier List (ASL) and supporting electronic quality systems to ensure operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. Working hours will be as per US time zone. This position will support Lexington site. 1) Document Review & QMS Support:
- Review and approve protocols, SOPs, and provide support to the Quality Management System (QMS) 2) SME QA Support:
- Provide subject matter expert (SME) QA support during night shifts 3) Risk & Trend Analysis:

title: Executive-Production
jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. Our capability as an integrated service provider & experience with various technologies enables us to serve Innovator and Generic companies worldwide. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Executive-Production Job Description Carry out production activities safely and as per company quality, safety, and manufacturing procedures to achieve the daily production plan. Ensure products are manufactured according to GMP standards while maintaining productivity, quality, and safety. Key Responsibilities Ensure raw materials are available for daily production as per the production plan. Operate, clean, and maintain production and utility equipment as assigned. Follow GMP, Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) requirements. Monitor and maintain process parameters as per the Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR). Execute the production plan and achieve daily production targets. Use manpower, equipment, utilities, raw materials, and power efficiently. Issue and control intermediates during production. Maintain cleanliness and good housekeeping in the production area. Complete production and cleaning records accurately and on time. Identify and resolve basic equipment and process issues and report major problems when required. Raise work orders and obtain safety permits as per company procedures. Suggest and support process improvement initiatives. Participate in activities to improve yield, reduce process time, and increase productivity. Keep the production area audit-ready at all times. Follow all safety practices to protect employees, equipment, and the workplace. Coordinate with Quality, Engineering, Warehouse, Maintenance, and other support teams for smooth production. Attend training programs and apply the learning in day-to-day work. Report near misses, unsafe acts, and unsafe conditions immediately. Handle hazardous chemicals and production operations safely by following approved procedures. Ensure proper shift handover by communicating all production updates clearly. Collect and submit in-process samples to QC/ARD and follow up on test results. Perform any other production-related activities assigned by the reporting manager. Qualifications Diploma / B.Sc. / B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry. 4 –6 years of experience in a pharmaceutical, API manufacturing industry. Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and EHS requirements. Willingness to work in shifts. jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Critical Care Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. We are motivated by our vision of commitment to delivering critical care solutions for patients and healthcare providers across the globe while achieving sustainable and profitable growth for all the stakeholders. PCC maintains a wide presence across the US, Europe, and more than 100 countries across the globe. Its rich product portfolio includes Inhalation Anesthetics such as Sevoflurane, Isoflurane and Halothane as well as Intrathecal Baclofen therapy, for spasticity management. PCC has a strong manufacturing and process development experience with wholly-owned, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in the United States and India, inspected periodically by the US FDA and the UK MHRA and other regulators. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs. For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/ Job Title Deputy Manager-Production ( Drug Product ) Job Description The incumbent is responsible for ensuring compliance with c GMP requirements and supporting the smooth execution of production operations through effective documentation, quality systems, validation, and compliance activities. The role involves maintaining manufacturing records in compliance with data integrity requirements, coordinating with cross-functional teams, managing GMP documentation, supporting audits, qualification and validation activities, reviewing production records and defect trends, handling SAP, ENSUR, and Track Wise system activities, and driving safety and training initiatives. The position plays a key role in maintaining regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement within the production function. Job Summary** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Deputy Manager-Production to oversee and optimize drug product manufacturing operations at our state-of-the-art facility. This role involves ensuring efficient production, maintaining quality standards, and leading a team to achieve production targets. Job Responsibilities** * Supervise and manage all aspects of drug product manufacturing, including compounding, filling, lyophilization, and packaging, ensuring compliance with c GMP regulations and company SOPs. * Develop and implement production schedules, monitor progress, and troubleshoot any deviations to meet production targets and deadlines. * Lead, mentor, and train a team of production operators and supervisors, fostering a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement. * Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Engineering, and Supply Chain departments to resolve manufacturing issues, implement process improvements, and ensure timely availability of materials and equipment. * Conduct investigations into deviations, non-conformances, and CAPAs, identifying root causes and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. * Review and approve batch records, production reports, and other relevant documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness. * Participate in regulatory inspections and audits, providing necessary documentation and support. * Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, cost reduction, and efficiency improvement within the production department. * Ensure all safety protocols and environmental regulations are strictly adhered to within the production area. Job Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Technology, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. * 5-8 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, with a minimum of 2-3 years in a supervisory or managerial role within drug product production (sterile or non-sterile). * Strong understanding and practical application of c GMP, ICH guidelines, and other relevant regulatory requirements. * Proven experience in aseptic processing, filling operations, and lyophilization is highly desirable. * Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate, develop, and manage a diverse team. * Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities. * Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills. * Proficiency in using manufacturing execution systems (MES) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software. jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. Our capability as an integrated service provider & experience with various technologies enables us to serve Innovator and Generic companies worldwide. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Deputy Manager & PMO Coordinator Job Description Integral member of the Global PMO team responsible for coordinating with other Global PMO Team members to support on-going initiatives. Initiatives will include, but not limited to Monthly Global PM Team Meeting attendance and participation tracking, new PM On-boarding process maintenance, issuing of Project Workspaces and maintenance of the PMO Coordinator Manual. Coordinator will also be responsible to create and maintain the Global PM Intranet site along with keeping all IT systems, process maps and tools related to Global Project Management up to date. •Integral member of Global PMO team taking ownership of the continued development and maintenance of the PM Intranet site, the development and maintenance of Project Management Process Maps and training curriculum to support these process maps and the monthly change order review and reporting process. • •With support of local and Global PM teams, organize meetings to gather input from global PM’s and key stakeholders to learn the specific processes to support the creation of the process maps. • •Responsible for collecting and maintaining metrics on all global Project Managers including global meeting attendance and participation. • •With support of the Learning and Development team as well as other Global PMO team members, create training content to accompany the PM Processes. • •Support creation and manage the content of the Global PM Intranet Site including researching industry news and client information. Collaborate with sites for site specific content to be included. • • Provide regular updates to stakeholders, present to senior leadership on project status and progress. • •Proximity to an existing Piramal site is preferred, some travel may be required •Excellent understanding of project management processes related to pharmaceutical discovery, development and manufacturing, from project initiation to closeout. • •Self Driven to stay on task while working remotely. • •Strong communication skills (Excellent command of English is necessary) with the ability to interact effectively with a cross-section of stakeholders in multiple time zones. •Strong presentation skills with the ability to present interactively and engage listeners in a two-way conversation. • •Personal initiative, persuasiveness, assertiveness and collaborative approach. • •Results oriented. Able to take process/user requirements and translate into a solution. • •Extremely well versed with technology with the ability to learn new systems quickly. Experience with Smartsheet, MS Office applications, Qlik Sense (or other power BI tool) preferred. title: Senior Research Associate-AD
jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. title: Senior Executive - SharePoint Developer
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Job Description Senior Executive
- Share Point Developer Job Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Executive
- Share Point Developer to design, develop, implement, and maintain robust Share Point solutions. This role will be crucial in enhancing collaboration, automating business processes, and optimizing information management within Piramal Consumer Healthcare --- Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and implement custom Share Point solutions, including web parts, workflows, forms (Info Path, Power Apps), and reports, utilizing Share Point Online and on-premise environments. * Administer and configure Share Point sites, site collections, lists, libraries, permissions, and features to meet business requirements. * Collaborate with business users and stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze needs, and translate them into technical specifications for Share Point solutions. * Develop and maintain documentation for Share Point architecture, configurations, and developed solutions. * Provide technical support and troubleshooting for existing Share Point applications and infrastructure. * Ensure the security, integrity, and performance of Share Point environments. * Participate in the planning, testing, and deployment of Share Point upgrades and patches. * Stay up-to-date with the latest Share Point and Microsoft 365 developments and best practices. * Mentor junior developers and contribute to team knowledge sharing. * Adhere to company IT policies, procedures, and change management processes. --- Job Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * 5+ years of hands-on experience in Share Point development and administration, with a strong focus on Share Point Online (Microsoft 365) and prior experience with Share Point 2013/2016/2019. * Proficiency in client-side development technologies including Java Script, j Query, HTML5, CSS3, and REST API. * Strong experience with Share Point Framework (SPFx) for building custom web parts and extensions. * Expertise in developing custom workflows using Share Point Designer, Microsoft Flow/Power Automate. * Experience with Power Apps and Power BI integration within Share Point. * Solid understanding of Share Point architecture, object model, and security best practices. * Experience with Power Shell scripting for Share Point administration and automation. * Knowledge of C#, .NET development for custom Share Point solutions (advantageous). * Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. * Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. title: Chief Manager - Quality Assurance
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. Our capability as an integrated service provider & experience with various technologies enables us to serve Innovator and Generic companies worldwide. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Chief Manager
- Quality Assurance Job Description This role is Responsible for ensuring compliance with c GMP guidelines in the manufacturing and quality control. The role includes approving quality procedures, specifications, and batch records, as well as reviewing QMS elements such as Change Control, Deviation, CAPA, OOS/OOT, complaints, returns, and recalls. The incumbent will also ensure proper investigation and closure of quality issues, conduct internal audits, and perform vendor evaluation for raw and packaging materials to maintain quality standards. Release or rejection of all APIs. Establishment of system as per CGMP to release or reject raw materials, intermediate packaging and labelling materials. Approving all procedures impacting the quality of intermediates or APIs. Review & approval of the QMS elements like Change Control. Deviation, CAPA, OOT, Customer Complaint, Return Goods & Recall. Final review and authorization of completed batch production laboratory control record before release of the API for distribution. Ensure all deviations, OOS, OOT are properly investigated and closed. Approving all specifications and master production instruction. Approving all the procedures that potentially impacting the quality of Raw materials. Intermediate and APIs. Conducting Internal Audits (Self-Inspections). Making sure that internal audits (Self-Inspections) are performed. Conduct vendor evaluation of Raw Material & Packaging materials. Ensure Customer Complaints, Return Goods & Product Recall are properly investigated and closed. Reviewing and approving validation protocols and reports. Review and approving all the changes that potentially impact intermediate or API quality. Make sure that effective systems are used for maintaining and calibrating critical equipment. Make sure that materials are appropriately tested and results are reported. Make sure that there is stability data to support retest or expiry dates and storage condition on APIs and/or intermediate where appropriate. I Approval of Preventive Maintenance & Calibration of equipment and systems. Performing product quality reviews. Ensure the compliance of all the system as per CGMP requirements. Facing Customer and regulatory Audits. Ensure timely responses to the customer and regulatory queries. - Packaging Development The incumbent will be responsible for obtaining the best and cost effective packaging for existing and new products. This position will be responsible for strategy designing around innovation and sustainability in packaging. Observing, analyzing and research market trends and new age packaging for FMCH (Fast Moving Consumer Healthcare) business for OTC, BPC and baby care category. Develop and implement scientific and efficient packaging process for PCH Product portfolio. •Lead Packaging Design & Development for diverse portfolio ranging from Personal care, Home Care, Food Supplement, Baby Care, Commodity Products, Medical Devices and Self-Care medicines. •Lead & Develop all the NPD projects as per marketing brief with value addition inputs for topline growth and •Responsible to deliver project timelines for task that involve packaging and ability to work in micro soft project environment •Responsible to keep track of price movements of packing materials & •Developing artworks for the packing materials in line with Marketing requirements and responsible for final printing •People Management and Development •Empower team members to move across existing opportunities and take on responsibilities independently. title: Senior Executive- Marketing
jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Job Description Senior Executive- Marketing The role is responsible for supporting digital marketing, consumer engagement, customer experience, and consumer insight initiatives across brands. The individual will work closely with internal teams, agencies, and external partners to execute campaigns, manage consumer interactions, generate actionable insights, and deliver seamless marketing and consumer experience programs that support brand growth Job Responsibilities** * Develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans and campaigns for various pharmaceutical products, adhering to regulatory guidelines. * Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats, informing strategic marketing decisions. * Collaborate closely with sales, product development, and regulatory teams to ensure integrated marketing efforts. * Manage and optimize digital marketing initiatives, including SEO, SEM, social media, and email marketing. * Oversee the creation of compelling marketing collateral, including presentations, brochures, website content, and promotional materials. * Organize and represent the company at industry conferences, trade shows, and other marketing events. * Monitor and analyze marketing campaign performance, providing regular reports and actionable insights to senior management. * Manage marketing budgets, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and adherence to financial targets. * Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in pharmaceutical marketing. Job Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration * 2-5 years of experience in marketing roles within the D2C or Marketing Agency. * Proven track record of successfully developing and executing marketing strategies that achieved measurable results. * Strong understanding of pharmaceutical regulations, compliance requirements, and ethical marketing practices. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling messages for diverse audiences. * Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, SEO tools, social media management). * Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. * Demonstrated project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. title: Deputy Manager - Accounts Payable
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Job Description Deputy Manager
- Accounts Payable The Deputy Manager – Domestic Payments is responsible for managing end-to-end domestic payment operations for vendor and employee reimbursements through SAP S/4HANA. The role ensures timely and accurate payment processing, compliance with statutory and company policies, effective stakeholder management, and continuous process improvement. The incumbent works closely with Accounts Payable, Treasury, Tax, Procurement, HR, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless payment execution while maintaining strong internal controls and operational efficiency. Manage end-to-end domestic payment processing for vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, advances, and other business-related payments through SAP S/4HANA. Ensure all payments are processed accurately within defined turnaround times and in accordance with company policies. Review and approve payment proposals, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal controls. Coordinate payment runs through banking portals and monitor successful payment execution. Handle urgent, ad hoc, and high-value payments while ensuring appropriate approvals. Execute and monitor payment runs using SAP S/4HANA. Resolve payment blocks, exceptions, duplicate payments, rejected transactions, and system-related issues. Work with the SAP support team to identify system enhancements, automation opportunities, and issue resolution. Ensure accurate master data related to vendors, payment methods, and bank details. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports related to payment volumes, ageing, payment failures, exceptions, and productivity. Analyse trends and recommend corrective actions to improve payment performance. Support management with dashboards and operational metrics. title: Apprentice
jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Job Description Apprentice Responsible for managing end-to-end Learning & Development operations, including LMS administration, learner management, course configuration, reporting, and process compliance. Provides operational and technical support to users and stakeholders, ensuring seamless execution of learning programs, data accuracy, and adherence to SLAs. Coordinates learning logistics, communications, and continuous improvement of learning systems and processes to enhance employee learning experience. LMS Administration Manage end-to-end LMS operations and administration. Create and maintain learning plans, assessments, courses, sessions, curricula, and learning content on the LMS. Upload and manage learning materials, documents, and other training-related content. Configure and maintain learning programs, certifications, and learner journeys. Perform periodic audits of LMS content to ensure accuracy, relevance, and compliance. Learner Management & Support Manage learner records, groups, enrollments, attendance, and completion status. Provide first-level support for learner and administrator queries related to LMS functionality. Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, system issues, and learner access concerns. Support site/business LMS administrators with system-related requirements and troubleshooting. Learning Operations Coordinate end-to-end logistics for classroom, virtual, and blended learning programs. Manage training calendars, nominations, participant registrations, and attendance tracking. Ensure timely communication of invitations, reminders, feedback requests, and other learner communications. Follow up with learners and stakeholders to complete mandatory actions such as feedback submissions, IDPs, and action plans. Reporting & Analytics Generate periodic MIS, dashboards, reports, and analytics related to learning activities. Maintain learning databases and ensure data accuracy and integrity. Track training completion, certifications, compliance training, and other key metrics. Provide insights and reports to support learning governance and decision-making. Stakeholder Management Act as a central point of contact for operational L&D queries received through functional mailboxes. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, trainers, vendors, business HR teams, and LMS administrators. Support smooth execution of enterprise learning initiatives and programs. Process Excellence & Compliance Ensure adherence to defined SLAs, TATs, and operational standards. Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within L&D operations. Support audits, compliance requirements, and ad hoc learning administration activities. Key Skills Learning Operations Management Data Management & Reporting MS Excel and Analytics Stakeholder Management Problem Solving & Troubleshooting Process Orientation Communication & Coordination Attention to Detail Customer Service Orientation Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) SLA/TAT adherence Training program execution effectiveness Learner query resolution timelines Report accuracy and timeliness Mandatory learning completion rates Stakeholder satisfaction levels Introduce yourself to our recruiters and we'll get in touch if there's a role that seems like a good match. title: Senior Manager Trade Marketing
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Job Description Senior Manager Trade Marketing The Senior Manager Trade Marketing will be responsible for supporting the design, rollout, and performance tracking of category-led customer marketing programs across all channels including General Trade (GT), Modern Trade (MT), Supermarkets (SM), and emerging channels as applicable. The role will work closely with Sales Development, Sales teams, Brand Marketing, Category/Product teams, and Regional Customer Marketing Managers to translate category priorities into strong customer marketing programs that drive visibility, shopper engagement, outlet productivity and off-take growth. This role will ensure programs are delivered with high quality through strong planning, cross-functional coordination, channel customization, KPI tracking and continuous optimization using insights and learnings KEY ROLES/

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•Support development and rollout of category-led customer marketing programs across all channels aligned to annual category priorities •Create and standardize program frameworks and toolkits, including: •POSM / visibility toolkits •activation guidelines and SOPs •channel-wise customization playbooks •tracking formats and scorecards •Coordinate with regional teams to drive effective rollout and adherence, ensuring: •timely communication and readiness •channel-wise execution alignment •closure of gaps identified during rollouts •Drive cross-functional coordination with: •Sales teams for execution alignment •Supply chain for product readiness and availability •Finance for spend utilization and documentation governance •Brand team for messaging consistency (where applicable) •Track, analyse and report program performance using KPIs such as: •secondary/primary uplift •visibility compliance •outlet productivity and activation impact •execution scorecards •post-activity ROI / learnings •Maintain program dashboards and consolidate regional learnings into best practices •Monitor competitor activities and market trends across channels and recommend improvement areas •Support capability building by contributing to training modules and conducting sessions for internal teams as needed •Ensure process discipline and documentation readiness for claims, spends and audits KEY COMPETENCIES: •Strong understanding of trade/customer marketing across channels •Strong program management capability (multi-market rollouts) •High execution orientation with attention to detail •Analytical skills to interpret KPIs, recommend improvements and optimize programs •Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills •Effective communication and presentation skills (review readiness with leadership) •Agility to adapt programs based on changing market/channel needs •Process orientation and governance discipline (spend documentation, compliance) MBA – title: Deputy Manager - Production (API)
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Critical Care Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. We are motivated by our vision of commitment to delivering critical care solutions for patients and healthcare providers across the globe while achieving sustainable and profitable growth for all the stakeholders. PCC maintains a wide presence across the US, Europe, and more than 100 countries across the globe. Its rich product portfolio includes Inhalation Anesthetics such as Sevoflurane, Isoflurane and Halothane as well as Intrathecal Baclofen therapy, for spasticity management. PCC has a strong manufacturing and process development experience with wholly-owned, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in the United States and India, inspected periodically by the US FDA and the UK MHRA and other regulators. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs. For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/ Job Title Deputy Manager
- Production (API) Job Description
1. To handle shift as shift in charge whenever required.
2. Follow instructions from Manager for the general shift activities.
3. To operate DCS as supervisor & review DCS alarms.
4. Ensure batch charging & other manufacturing operations should be strictly as per BMR/SOP & in line with current GMP practices while working as shift in charge.
1. To handle shift as shift in charge whenever required.
2. Follow instructions from Manager for the general shift activities.
3. To operate DCS as supervisor & review DCS alarms.
4. Ensure batch charging & other manufacturing operations should be strictly as per BMR/SOP & in line with current GMP practices while working as shift in charge.
5. To maintain manufacturing records online & should comply data integrity practices.
6. To take out sample of intermediate/in-process material and send to IPQC/QC lab.
7. To enter and ensure the production related inputs in SAP system.
8. To be check and ensure the PISCADA reports generation.
9. Transfer finished goods through “Finished Goods Transfer Note”.
10. To Check and ensure minimum stock of consumables, Log books & status labels.
11. Ensuring preventive maintenance of all equipment as per schedule.
12. Co-ordinate with service departments (QA, QC, stores, E & M) for various production related activities.
13. If any major abnormality found in production area / activities, authorized to stop activity immediately & inform to superiors/production Manager.
14. Responsible to maintain housekeeping in plant & take care the cleanliness of equipment.
15. Follow safety instructions/procedures & ensure use of safety outfit while on works.
16. To attend GMP & safety trainings & implement the trainings outcome at workplace.
17. To conduct training to all staff as trainer.
18. Should be aware of the location of firefighting equipment and should know the operation.
19. Report any incident, near miss in my safe portal.
20. Rectify all safety and GMP related observations.
21. He should not leave the work spot unattended and go away without prior permission from Manager.
22. Responsible for allotment of work to operators & casuals.
23. To involve in other initiatives such as AET & CSR.
24. Responsible to carry out the work of his senior in the absence of senior or authorization from senior.
25. To prepare and perform operational and performance qualification protocol.
26. Preparation of SOP’s, BMR, Protocol, Records etc.
27. He should handle Docu Sign, ensure, track wise activities.
28. He should handle all QMS activities. title: Senior Executive-QA
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. Our capability as an integrated service provider & experience with various technologies enables us to serve Innovator and Generic companies worldwide. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Senior Executive-QA Job Description Engineering Assurance professional with 5–6 years of experience in ensuring compliance, reliability, and performance of engineering systems in regulated environments. Experienced in conducting internal audits, vendor qualification, equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), and ensuring adherence to GMP, SOPs, and regulatory standards. Skilled in deviation handling, CAPA implementation, risk assessment, and documentation review to maintain quality and operational excellence. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, support inspections, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Strong knowledge of engineering controls, utilities, and validation practices with a focus on compliance and data integrity. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Ensure compliance of engineering systems with GMP, regulatory guidelines, and company SOPs. Perform and support equipment qualification activities (IQ, OQ, PQ) and requalification. Review and approve engineering documents such as URS, DQ, protocols, reports, and SOPs. Conduct internal audits and support external/customer/regulatory audits. Handle deviations, change controls, and CAPA related to engineering systems. Perform risk assessments (FMEA/Risk-based approach) for equipment and utilities. Ensure proper maintenance and calibration of equipment and critical instruments. Monitor and review utility systems (HVAC, water systems, compressed air, etc.) for compliance. Ensure data integrity and proper documentation practices in all engineering records. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (QA, Production, QC, Warehouse) for compliance activities. Support vendor qualification and evaluation of engineering service providers. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in engineering and compliance systems. Key Skills & Competencies: Strong knowledge of GMP, GDP, and regulatory requirements (USFDA, EU GMP, WHO). Hands-on experience in qualification and validation activities. Good understanding of utilities and facility systems. Expertise in deviation investigation and CAPA management. Strong documentation and audit handling skills. Problem-solving and analytical thinking. Effective communication and teamwork abilities. title: Executive - Production
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Critical Care Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. We are motivated by our vision of commitment to delivering critical care solutions for patients and healthcare providers across the globe while achieving sustainable and profitable growth for all the stakeholders. PCC maintains a wide presence across the US, Europe, and more than 100 countries across the globe. Its rich product portfolio includes Inhalation Anesthetics such as Sevoflurane, Isoflurane and Halothane as well as Intrathecal Baclofen therapy, for spasticity management. PCC has a strong manufacturing and process development experience with wholly-owned, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in the United States and India, inspected periodically by the US FDA and the UK MHRA and other regulators. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs. For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/ Job Title Executive
- Production Job Description

2. Ensure batch charging & other manufacturing operations should be strictly as per BMR/ SOP & in line with current GMP practices.
3. To maintain manufacturing records online & should comply data integrity practices.
4. To take out sample of intermediate/in-process material and send to IPQC/QC lab.

21. Responsible to handle all the QMS documentation work in the production block.

title: Senior Executive-HR
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. Our capability as an integrated service provider & experience with various technologies enables us to serve Innovator and Generic companies worldwide. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Senior Executive-HR Job Description The Senior Executive – Administration will be responsible for managing end-to-end site administration and employee support services across the site ensuring a safe, compliant, efficient and employee-centric workplace. The role will drive day-to-day administration including housekeeping, security, transport, cafeteria, facility services, contract labour governance, vendor management, office infrastructure, statutory compliance and employee engagement support. The incumbent will work closely with HR, Engineering, EHS, Quality, Procurement and business functions to ensure seamless site operations while driving operational excellence, cost optimization and continuous improvement initiatives. 1.Site Administration & Employee Services •Ensure smooth day-to-day administration across the site. •Manage housekeeping, washrooms, common areas, pantry, cafeteria, horticulture and employee amenities. •Coordinate employee seating, workstation readiness and office movements. •Support employee engagement activities, townhalls and site events from an administration perspective. •Ensure timely closure of administration complaints raised/employee feedback.
2. Facility Management •Coordinate upkeep of office buildings, laboratories, utilities and common infrastructure. •Work closely with Engineering for preventive maintenance, civil works and infrastructure improvements. •Monitor housekeeping quality through regular audits and defined service levels. •Coordinate pest control, drinking water systems, waste disposal and landscaping activities.
3. Vendor & Contract Management •Manage end-to-end administration vendors including housekeeping, transport, security, cafeteria, horticulture, pest control and facility service providers. •Monitor vendor KPIs, manpower deployment, statutory compliance and service quality. •Conduct periodic vendor review meetings. •Recommend process improvements and cost optimization initiatives. •Process purchase requisitions, work orders, invoices and service certifications.
4. Contract Labour Management •Coordinate administration-related contractual manpower deployment. •Ensure attendance validation through CLMS/Face Recognition systems. •Monitor contractor statutory compliance including PF, ESIC, labour licenses, wage registers and supporting documentation. •Support audits related to contract labour management.
5. Security & Access Management •Oversee security operations including visitor management, access control and gate operations. •Coordinate CCTV monitoring, access cards, key management and security agency performance. •Ensure compliance with site security procedures and emergency response protocols.
6. Transport Administration •Coordinate employee transport operations. •Monitor bus occupancy, route optimization and vendor performance. •Address transport-related employee concerns. •Support implementation of transport cost optimization initiatives.
7. Compliance & Audit Readiness •Maintain administration SOPs, records and statutory documentation. •Ensure readiness for customer audits, GMP, GLP, ISO, EHS and internal audits. •Track administration CAPAs and ensure timely closure. •Maintain administration documentation as per regulatory requirements.
8. Budget & Cost Management •Track administration expenses against approved budgets. •Monitor and process vendor invoices for payment. •Identify and implement administration cost optimization initiatives. •Generate monthly MIS on administration expenditure and service performance.
9. Continuous Improvement •Drive digitization and automation initiatives across administration. •Develop dashboards and MIS for vendor performance, complaints, transport, housekeeping and administration KPIs. •Benchmark best practices across Piramal sites. •Lead at least one administration improvement project every year. jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Critical Care Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. PCC maintains a wide presence across the US, Europe, and more than 100 countries across the globe. Its rich product portfolio includes Inhalation Anesthetics such as Sevoflurane, Isoflurane and Halothane as well as Intrathecal Baclofen therapy, for spasticity management. PCC has a strong manufacturing and process development experience with wholly-owned, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in the United States and India, inspected periodically by the US FDA and the UK MHRA and other regulators. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs. For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/ Job Title Deputy Manager
- Production (API) Job Description
1. To handle shift as shift in charge whenever required.
2. Follow instructions from Manager for the general shift activities.
3. To operate DCS as supervisor & review DCS alarms.
4. Ensure batch charging & other manufacturing operations should be strictly as per BMR/SOP & in line with current GMP practices while working as shift in charge.
5. To maintain manufacturing records online & should comply data integrity practices.
1. To handle shift as shift in charge whenever required.
2. Follow instructions from Manager for the general shift activities.
3. To operate DCS as supervisor & review DCS alarms.
4. Ensure batch charging & other manufacturing operations should be strictly as per BMR/SOP & in line with current GMP practices while working as shift in charge.
5. To maintain manufacturing records online & should comply data integrity practices.
6. To take out sample of intermediate/in-process material and send to IPQC/QC lab.
7. To enter and ensure the production related inputs in SAP system.
8. To be check and ensure the PISCADA reports generation.
9. Transfer finished goods through “Finished Goods Transfer Note”.
10. To Check and ensure minimum stock of consumables, Log books & status labels.
11. Ensuring preventive maintenance of all equipment as per schedule.
12. Co-ordinate with service departments (QA, QC, stores, E & M) for various production related activities.
13. If any major abnormality found in production area / activities, authorized to stop activity immediately & inform to superiors/production Manager.
14. Responsible to maintain housekeeping in plant & take care the cleanliness of equipment.
15. Follow safety instructions/procedures & ensure use of safety outfit while on works.
16. To attend GMP & safety trainings & implement the trainings outcome at workplace.
17. To conduct training to all staff as trainer.
18. Should be aware of the location of firefighting equipment and should know the operation.
19. Report any incident, near miss in my safe portal.
20. Rectify all safety and GMP related observations.
21. He should not leave the work spot unattended and go away without prior permission from Manager.
22. Responsible for allotment of work to operators & casuals.
23. To involve in other initiatives such as AET & CSR.
24. Responsible to carry out the work of his senior in the absence of senior or authorization from senior.
25. To prepare and perform operational and performance qualification protocol.
26. Preparation of SOP’s, BMR, Protocol, Records etc.
27. He should handle Docu Sign, ensure, track wise activities. He should handle all QMS activities. title: Senior Executive-Microbiology
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Pharma Solutions Piramal Pharma Solutions is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering end-to-end development and manufacturing solutions across the drug life cycle. We serve our clients through a globally integrated network of facilities in North America, Europe and Asia. This enables us to offer a comprehensive range of services including Drug Discovery Solutions, Process & Pharmaceutical Development services, Clinical Trial Supplies, Commercial supply of APIs and Finished dosage forms. We also offer specialized services like development and manufacture of Highly Potent APIs and Antibody Drug Conjugation. Our capability as an integrated service provider & experience with various technologies enables us to serve Innovator and Generic companies worldwide. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Senior Executive-Microbiology Job Description Responsible for water sampling and microbiological testing, environmental monitoring, microbial limit testing, microbial culture handling and laboratory documentation. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Sampling and Microbial analysis of water sample. Perform microbiological analysis of raw materials, finished products and stability samples in compliance with applicable procedures. Execute microbial limit test validation. Conduct Environmental Monitoring of classified areas by settle plate, active air (volumetric air sampling), and surface swab sampling methods. Handle, maintain, and preserve microbial cultures according to laboratory procedures. Prepare, sterilize, and manage culture media and laboratory reagents. Participate in qualification of BOD Incubator, Refrigerator, Deep freezer and Autoclave. Preservative Efficacy testing. Prepare trend charts and summary reports for water system monitoring and environmental monitoring data. Prepare and maintain laboratory documentation such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), protocols, reports, logbooks, and records. Provide inputs in Quality Management System (QMS) related to the Microbiology Laboratory, including change control, deviation, CAPA. title: Executive - Production
jobDescription:
Executive
1. To maintain department cleanliness.
2. To get optimum productivity within specified quality by effective utilization of available resources so as to deliver the product as per market requirement.
3. To order stereos, receive them, take impression, the issuance and destruction of rubber stereos.
4. Responsible for providing quality product and maintaining quality system of company.
5. Ensuring avoidance of breach of data integrity at all the levels.
6. To maintain month wise average batch yield record.
7. To determine internal and external QEHS issues as well as needs and expectations of relevant interested parties and monitor the same.
8. To implement QEHS policy & objectives.
9. To ensure participation and consultation of worker.
10. Ensure use of PPE.
11. To identify & communicate incidents, QEHS non conformities, investigate and take corrective actions on the same.
12. To ensure work permit system during maintenance activities
13. To implement QEHS continual improvement projects at site and monitor.
14. To ensure disposal of waste.
15. To prepare and review departmental documents.
16. To Coordination, Monitoring and controlling of departmental activities as per c GMP norms.
17. To allocate manpower.
18. To check and monitor the Manufacturing and Packing activities in the department.
19. To do in process checks and update departmental records.
20. Ensuring implementation of effective sanitation activities at all the levels.
21. To do online completed batches SAP entries and close process orders.
22. To impart training to the operators and workers and maintain records.
23. To check the raw material and packing material availability in SAP.
24. To report incident to Human resources and safety department.
25. To make a plan of manpower requirement to meet the expected output and delivery schedules under the guidance of HOD.
26. To utilize man, machine and material including natural resources like Electricity, Water, Steam and Compressed air to get higher productivity.
27. To ensure proper segregation of material, quality of products, cleanliness of machines, walls, flooring, ceiling, windows and scrap area.
28. To co-ordinate with QA, QC, Stores, HR, IT, EHS and Engg. Department.
29. To prepare Shift Schedule.
30. To ensure that preventive maintenance of the machines is done by maintenance department.
31. To ensure compliance to internal and external audits.
32. To investigate the market complaint. Introduce yourself to our recruiters and we'll get in touch if there's a role that seems like a good match. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Executive
- Store Job Description The Executive – Stores is responsible for managing end-to-end store operations, including receiving, storing, and dispensing materials as per SOP and c GMP guidelines. The role involves preparing GRNs, quarantine labels, and stock register entries, coordinating with QC for sampling and retesting, and maintaining daily records such as area cleaning, temperature/RH, and balance verification. The Executive also handles QMS documentation (Change Control, Deviation, CAPA, OOS) and ensures safe material handling while coordinating with staff for smooth store functioning. Receiving of materials & filling the checklist of received materials as per SOP Storing the materials as per their storage condition at designated place Taking Inward entry & Preparing GRN of received materials & sending it to QC Dept. for sampling & analysis. Preparing quarantine label & getting it pasted to each container by the worker Updating stock register with the receipt and issuance entry Updating daily records like area cleaning. Temp & Rh, balance verification Dispensing Issuing of materials to production as per the requisition and updating the stock register with the receipt entry Handling & movement of materials in stores with compliance to safety norms Preparing list of raw materials due for retesting and sending retest sample note to QC QMS documentation related Change Controls. For more details, please visit : www.piramalpharmasolutions.com Job Title Senior Executive-QA Job Description IPQA Senior Executive is responsible for ensuring that manufacturing and other processes comply with c GMP (current Good Manufacturing Practices) and internal quality standards. The individual actively monitors in-process operations, conducts line clearance, reviews batch documentation, and supports regulatory compliance to maintain product quality, safety and efficacy. Conduct in-process quality assurance (IPQA) checks across various areas of the facility to ensure compliance with quality standards. Ensure effective implementation of systems and procedures in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (c GMP) across the site, along with proper documentation. Ensure line clearance during product changeovers to prevent mix-ups and contamination. Verify Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensure procedural compliance on the shop floor Verify Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR), Equipment Cleaning Records (ECR), logbooks, and other documentation for completeness and contemporaneous entries. Identify and report potential risks of contamination or cross-contamination within the facility. Ensure compliance with data integrity principles during all site activities. Monitor and verify that materials are stored under defined conditions and appropriately labeled. Ensure that deviations are reported in real-time and documented as per procedure. Conduct periodic reviews of quality records to ensure accuracy and completeness. Train shop floor personnel on SOPs, protocols, and quality standards. Review and trend alarm data as required to support quality and compliance. Manage Quality Management System (QMS) activities including documentation and follow-up. Review schedules and records related to validation, qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance (PM). Conduct internal audits (self-inspections) to assess compliance and identify areas for improvement. Prepare and review SOPs to ensure clarity, accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Review Annual Product Reports (APR) to assess product performance and compliance. Support Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) activities, ensure timely completion of EHS tasks, and report near misses and incidents as per EHS guidelines. Perform any other responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department (HOD). Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and safety guidelines. 1. Machine setting.
2. Machine change over.
3. To do departmental activities as per c GMP norms.
4. To give optimum productivity with subsequent improvement in it as per need, within specified time and quality by effective utilization of available resources so as to deliver the product as per market requirement.
5. To maintain department cleanliness.
6. To train subordinates.
7. To determine internal and external QEHS issues as well as needs and expectations of relevant interested parties and monitor the same.
8. To implement QEHS policy & objectives.
9. Ensure use of PPE.
10. To identify hazards & risk of defined process and control on it (Unsafe condition / Reporting of near miss, accidents)
11. To identify & communicate incidents QEHS non conformities, investigate and take corrective actions on the same.
12. To ensure work permit system during maintenance.
13. To participate and consult EHS activities to promote the EHS culture in the organization.
14. To implement QEHS continual improvement projects at site and monitor.
15. Responsible for providing quality product and maintaining quality system of company.
16. To avoid of breach of data integrity at all the levels.
17. Do proper sanitation activities at all the levels.
18. Cross verification of Raw Material and packing material.
19. Daily Verification of weighing balance.
20. Update door status label of area, Weight, label & record the weight of blended powder in BMR.
21. Follow gowning procedure and use proper PPEs before entering into production areas.

- DMS Job Description The primary objective of the role is to drive the implementation of the Lean Daily Management System across the PPS manufacturing sites. The role holder should engage in enhancing the DMS framework and its deployment in line with the OE framework and LRP. Providing academic and hands-on support to the site OE leads and Site teams for DMS KEY STAKEHOLDERS: INTERNAL The site leadership team, the Global OE head, and the Central partner functions KEY STAKEHOLDERS: EXTERNAL Vendors, Consulting firms REPORTING STRUCTURE: The role directly reports to the AGM, DMS & Special projects- Operational Excellence QUALIFICATION: B Tech in Chemical/Mechanical/Industrial Engineering or M.Pharm, Lean Six Sigma BB certified EXPERIENCE: 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in the area of Operational Excellence at any manufacturing location/Corporate/Consulting firm. Strong exposure to the deployment of Lean production Systems/ Daily Management System/ Policy Deployment/Factory Operating Systems Hands-on experience in leading & implementing Excellence Model & Daily Management Practices through teams in manufacturing sites (preferably Pharma), to bring cultural transformation and Lean mindset & behaviours. Should have driven projects/initiatives based on approaches i.e. Lean, To C, Six Sigma, etc SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES •Strong communication skills •Ability to build a strong working relationship with all stakeholders •Demonstrate high levels of Ownership & Accountability. •Ability to organize the work, plan well and prioritize based on impact •Action-oriented and results-driven. •Analytical with strong command over MS Excel, MS Powerpoint, Data Analytics, and Minitab Exposure to Industry 4.0 concepts •Should support the manager in defining strategy for the DMS roll-out, deployment, and maturation across the global mfg sites. •Should possess a good practical experience and knowledge of the DMS standards. Should be able to enhance the academics of the DMS standards i.e. Performance Management System, Problem Solving, Capability at Gemba, Leader Standard Work, Workplace Organization, and Standard work processes. •Provide on-site/remote assistance to the site OE leads and the teams, for smooth implementation of the DMS standards. Define self-LSW to have systematic process confirmation of the deployed DMS standards. •Should partner with the site OE leads to facilitate the strategy deployment process effectively and efficiently, towards the objective of Zero Defects, Zero Deterrents, Zero Harm, and Zero Waste. Can ensure the key burning issues of the sites are translated adequately through the PMS standard, across the tiers. •Ensure the business and site imperatives/KPIs are achieved through the DMS program. •Strategize and deliver the training events to enhance the capability of site OE resources and leaders on the DMS standards. •Should be able to work with the manager to enhance the DMS maturity model. Coaching & guiding function teams on this. Partner with his manager in conducting the DMS maturity assessment of the sites. •Conduct data analytics and diagnostics to identify improvement opportunities in processes. Amalgamate the thematic improvement projects with DMS elements, to enhance Productivity, Quality, Cost, Delivery, and safety continuously. •An expert in the use of Lean, To C, and Six Sigma tools & methodology. Coach and guide the users on utilizing these tools appropriately to implement projects and drive problem-solving. Should be able to proactively identify obstacles and thus assist in managing the projects. •Support the overall OE framework execution while partnering with the Focused improvement teams & Daily Management Teams. Drive improvements in the critical KPIs. •Facilitate drafting and sharing of the MIS and participate in the OE governance model. •Drive the digitalization of applicable DMS standards. jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Job Description Area Sales Manager We are looking for an experienced and result-driven Area Sales Manager to lead Area sales across the assigned territory. The role is responsible for driving business growth, strengthening distribution, leading a high-performing sales team, and ensuring excellent execution across retail markets. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in FMCG, OTC, Consumer Healthcare, or Personal Care, along with proven experience in territory management and team leadership. Key Responsibilities Business & Sales Management Drive primary and secondary sales to achieve business objectives. Develop and execute territory business plans and sales strategies. Forecast monthly and quarterly sales and monitor business performance. Analyse market trends, competition, and identify growth opportunities. Resolve customer complaints and ensure superior customer service. Coordinate with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and other support functions to ensure seamless business operations. Distribution & Infrastructure Management Develop and strengthen distributor networks across the territory. Ensure optimum stock availability and efficient inventory management. Monitor distributor performance, collections, and billing processes. Manage CFA operations to ensure smooth supply chain execution. Team Leadership & Capability Building Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Territory Sales Officers (TSOs), Territory Sales Incharges (TSIs), and Sales Officers (SOs). Conduct regular joint field visits to improve selling effectiveness and market execution. Drive product detailing, merchandising, visibility, and promotional excellence. Support recruitment, onboarding, and capability development of sales team members. Ensure timely reporting and adherence to company processes. Experience in leading large sales teams and delivering business growth. jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Critical Care Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. We are motivated by our vision of commitment to delivering critical care solutions for patients and healthcare providers across the globe while achieving sustainable and profitable growth for all the stakeholders. PCC maintains a wide presence across the US, Europe, and more than 100 countries across the globe. Its rich product portfolio includes Inhalation Anesthetics such as Sevoflurane, Isoflurane and Halothane as well as Intrathecal Baclofen therapy, for spasticity management. PCC has a strong manufacturing and process development experience with wholly-owned, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in the United States and India, inspected periodically by the US FDA and the UK MHRA and other regulators. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs. For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/ Job Title Senior Executive
- IPQA Job Description Responsible for ensuring compliance with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and quality systems throughout manufacturing operations. The role involves batch documentation review, in-process quality assurance activities, sample management, vendor qualification support, validation activities, document control, and coordination for product release.
1. Line clearance for production operations.
2. Review of BMR, BFR, BPR.
3. In
- process QA functions.
4. Control sample management.
5. Collection of In process / Finished product and customer samples.
6. Compilation of APQR data with trend analysis.
7. Participation in process validation, hold time studies etc.
8. Co-ordination for batch release.
9. Routine GMP verification in production and warehouse, production and all other departments.
10. Co-ordination and review of vendor management documents, compilation of vendor assessment reports.
11. Document Archival management as on when required. Issuance and control Formats, SOPs, Specifications and Batch Records. title: FTC - Shared Services
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Job Description FTC
- Shared Services Purchase Enablement executive Qualification and Experience Full time bachelor with minimum 60% throughout academic (BSC-IT, BCA, BMS, Bcom, BE)
- Excellent command over English communication is must, with ability to present / train vendors and site team, articulate thoughts
- Ability to work in cross cultural set-up
- Quick in learning the new technology, concepts related to Purchase.
- End user experience of Ariba, GEP, Coupa or any other purchase tool will be added advantage
- Full time or part time MBA would be added advantage.
- 1 to 3 years’ experience in procurement operations would be added advantage Job Responsibilities This position will be responsible for leading the efforts to increase the adoption level of Procurement platform (GEP PPa Ct supplier enablement) among the vendor community. This platform empowers buyers and vendors to digitize their transactions and improve the speed and accuracy. The activities involved
1. Maintain supplier rate catalogue in GEP PPa Ct and SAP
2. Monitor the accuracy of the rate catalogue and seek guidance from category team on revision of the catalogues.
3. Act as facilitator to schedule Live auctions and follow-up with vendors to ensure required vendors join the live-action. Performs the role of moderator during live auction
4. Follow-up with vendors to register on the GEP PPa Ct platform, understand and resolve their basic concerns, seek intervention from regional supply chain leader to convince nonconfirming vendors.
5. Understand the end to end concept of GEP PPa Ct and various activities performed such as RFx, rate catalogue, contracts, auctions, order confirmation, ASNs etc. and train the new joiners at site on how to use it
6. Support / facilitate with site team to create the new material codes, supplier codes
7. Act as helpdesk to resolve L1 level issues (knowledge gap) of end users and vendors about PPa Ct
8. Follow-up with vendors for getting order confirmations, Advance shipping notifications, Deliveries, Invoice uploads through GSP PPa Ct portal

title: Senior Executive-Accounts Payable
jobDescription: Be the First to Apply Job Description Senior Executive-Accounts Payable The Accounts Payable (AP) Executive will play a critical role within the GBSS Accounts Payable team by ensuring timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices. Operating within a SAP environment, the AP Executive will be responsible for booking 80–100 invoices per day in compliance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This role demands a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational skills, a commitment to meeting deadlines, and the ability to work efficiently in a high-volume, fast-paced setting. •Receiving invoices from operating departments for invoice processing and ensuring all approvals for vendor invoices are duly obtained. •Audit and correctly code AP Trade/IC invoices (both with & without PO's) •Process employee expense reports for accuracy and compliance with company policies and procedures. •Constantly Identify opportunities to improve Invoice booking process. •Identifies invoice and purchase order issues which cause reoccurring processing problems and disputed deductions. Work with supervisor to challenge status quo to resolve these continuing problems. Shift Time
- 4 pm to 1 am Work Method
- Hybrid based on approval from manager. Gender Diversity
- Only male candidate as it is for Night shift. Must have skills and qualification. Full time graduate with no education gap and at least 60% throughout the academic (BSc, Engineering , BCom) Excellent written and verbal English communication. SAP HANA or at least SAP ECC experience as end user Master data experience in material and Customer Master Master data reviews and governance techniques MS Excel skills Good to have skills and qualification. Experience in Vendor and Price Master Experience in SAP MDG as end user Masters qualification SAP certification. Essential Skills & Experience: · Good communication skills, both written and verbal, a must 3 to 5 years of experiences in master data management in SAP HANA / ECC environment Experience and through understanding of SAP as an end user is must. Demonstrated experience with SAP master data management & governance concepts. Working experience on SAP MDG would be an added advantage Ensures master data integrity in key systems & maintaining the processes with quality. Ability to work well with people at various levels and with different cultural backgrounds. Demonstrated proficiency using MS Office programs (Word, Excel, Power Point, Access, Visio etc.) Key Roles/

RESPONSIBILITIES:
The responsibilities and accountabilities of the position include but are not limited to the following: Serve as Global Master Data SME and provide support and expertise as required to all sites within the Business (primarily sites in US, UK and Canada) Maintain various masters in SAP like Material Master, vendor Master, Customer Master and Price master Understand the impact of the master data on downstream operations Apply standard POLICY CHECKs and DATA QUALITY checks on the new /change master data request received from the requestor. Coordinate with end users for missing information, approvals and data correction Maintain the service level of turnaround of 1 working day and 100% accuracy for all the new/change master data requests received from end users/ business / sites ( mainly from US, UK , Europe and Canada geographies Continue the development of data standards, processes and procedure for various master data domains. Identify areas of additional system control, automation, process standardization to ensure data quality, data standardization and data integrity is of highest standard Periodic review of the Standard Operating Procedures and update the same Provide support to SAP implementation projects by representing the MDM function in SAP testing, data cleansing, data migration. Work collaboratively with other functions (e.g. Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Sales, BD, IT, Manufacturing sites etc.) to ensure Master Data & Other related issues are resolved and objectives are met. title: Chief Manager - Production
jobDescription:
Be the First to Apply Division Piramal Critical Care Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. We are motivated by our vision of commitment to delivering critical care solutions for patients and healthcare providers across the globe while achieving sustainable and profitable growth for all the stakeholders. PCC maintains a wide presence across the US, Europe, and more than 100 countries across the globe. Its rich product portfolio includes Inhalation Anesthetics such as Sevoflurane, Isoflurane and Halothane as well as Intrathecal Baclofen therapy, for spasticity management. PCC has a strong manufacturing and process development experience with wholly-owned, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in the United States and India, inspected periodically by the US FDA and the UK MHRA and other regulators. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs. For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/ Job Title Chief Manager
- Production Job Description The incumbent will serve as the Chief Manager of Production, leading and overseeing all aspects of site production operations. This role will involve optimizing production processes, ensuring compliance with industry regulations, and driving efficiency and quality in the production facility. Additionally, he or she will be responsible for managing internal and external supply and customers. •Adherence to c GMP and safety norms in accordance with industry standards. •Demonstrating a strong ability to plan production cycles for all machinery within the plant by utilizing planning systems and material output requirements. Resolving critical escalations related to product manufacturing. •Ensuring efficient and cost-effective operations at the unit while meeting all quality, environmental, health, and safety (EHS), and regulatory standards. Ensuring adherence to all internal processes and statutory compliance. •Capacity planning and optimizing resource utilization to achieve cost leadership in the products manufactured at the site. •Developing short-term and long-term manufacturing and operations strategies. •Developing the capabilities of the team to meet customer expectations and fostering a customer-centric approach within the organization. •Leading continual improvement and operational excellence initiatives, providing long-term strategic direction to the site. •Demonstrating a strong ability to plan production cycles for all machinery within the plant using planning systems and material output requirements. Resolving critical escalations related to product manufacturing. •Promoting customer-centricity within the organization.
